name: PURPLE STYLE LABS LIMITED
summary: Purple Style Labs Limited operates as a fashion house, acquiring and managing designer brands and running an omni-channel platform for premium fashion retail. The company offers luxury fashion and lifestyle products, including premium designer wear, accessories, and jewellery through online and offline channels. It owns and manages multi-brand e-commerce websites such as Pernia's Pop-Up Shop, operates brick-and-mortar stores under the Pernia's Pop-Up Studio brand, and manages designer labels such as Wendell Rodricks and Hemant Trevedi.
